paragraphs: Macy's, Inc. (the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") is a premier omnichannel retail organization that operates 665 stores, websites and mobile applications under three iconic brands: Macy's, Bloomingdale's and Bluemercury. The Company sells a wide range of merchandise, including apparel and accessories, cosmetics, home furnishings and other consumer goods and operates across a broad spectrum that spans from value-conscious, off-price shoppers to premium luxury consumers. Macy's, Inc. leverages its multi-brand, multi-category and multi-channel model to provide a high level of flexibility to read and react to shifting consumer demand and caters to an annual customer base of nearly 40 million active consumers.

•Macy's is a modern department store that provides a wide range of merchandise, encompassing men's, women's and children's apparel and accessories, cosmetics, home furnishings and other consumer goods. Macy's seeks to attract a broad, middle-to-higher-income customer base by offering compelling, high-quality products, competitive pricing and trusted customer service across its physical and digital channels. To serve different customer segments and trade areas, Macy's operates full-line and smaller format locations and provides an off-price retail concept through its Macy's Backstage nameplate.

•Founded over 150 years ago, Bloomingdale's represents the Company's upscale, premium contemporary-to-luxury department store offering. Bloomingdale's caters to an affluent, multigenerational customer base and positions itself as a store of discovery through vibrant, highly curated shopping environments anchored by exceptional customer service. Bloomingdale's serves different customer segments and trade areas through its full-line and smaller format locations, Bloomies, as well as its off-price retail concept, Bloomingdale's The Outlet. In addition, Bloomingdale's maintains a global presence through its licensed partnerships in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and Al Zahra, Kuwait.

•Bluemercury is a premier luxury beauty and spa services retailer that pioneered a unique, client-first service model through its emphasis on hyper-personalized, high-quality and agnostic beauty interactions in convenient neighborhood locations. Bluemercury's product mix targets the affluent beauty enthusiast, focusing heavily on premium dermatological skincare, clinical treatments and an elevated fragrance assortment.
Macy's, Inc. was organized as a Delaware corporation in 1985, and, along with its predecessors, have operated department stores since 1830.

Our multi‑year enterprise strategy, Bold New Chapter, is designed to help the Company return to sustainable, profitable growth by improving the customer experience, elevating product relevance, evolving our store and digital footprint, investing in the growth areas of our business and modernizing our operating model. The strategy is organized around three pillars:

•Strengthen and Reimagine the Macy's Nameplate: We are focused on creating a more relevant and consistent omni-channel experience at Macy's by improving customer service, elevating and modernizing our merchandise assortments and brand curations and prioritizing investments in our go-forward store locations.

•Accelerate and Differentiate Luxury: We view Bloomingdale's and Bluemercury as differentiated growth platforms within our portfolio and are investing in these brands to support differentiated product curation, enhance customer service and expand digital and selective physical locations.

•Simplify and Modernize End-to-End Operations: We are modernizing our operating model to reduce complexity, improve speed, reliability and inventory productivity and self‑fund customer‑facing investments with cost savings driven by operational efficiencies.

We sell a wide range of merchandise, including apparel and accessories (men's, women's and kids'), cosmetics, home furnishings and other consumer goods. The specific assortments vary by size of store, merchandising assortments and
character of customers in the trade areas. Most stores are located at urban or suburban sites, principally in densely populated areas across the United States.

headings: Strategic, Operational and Competitive Risks
Our strategic plans and initiatives may not be successful, which could negatively affect our profitability and growth.

We may not timely identify or effectively respond to consumer needs, expectations, or trends, which could adversely affect our relationship with customers, the demand for our products and services and our market share.
Our advertising, marketing and loyalty programs may not be successful.
Our sales and operating results depend on our ability to manage our inventory, merchandise selection and protect against inventory shortage.
The Company faces significant competition and depends on its ability to differentiate itself in retail's ever-changing environment.
Our ability to grow depends in part on our stores remaining relevant and attractive to customers.
We may not be able to successfully execute our real estate strategy.
Our revenues and cash requirements are affected by the seasonal nature of our business.
We depend on our ability to attract, train, develop and retain quality colleagues.
Increases in labor costs and the cost of employee benefits could impact our financial results and cash flow.
If revenue from our private label and co-branded credit cards decline, our financial and operational results may be negatively impacted.
Our defined benefit plan funding requirements or plan settlement expense could impact our financial results and cash flow.
If our Company's reputation and brand image are not maintained at a high level, our operations and financial results may suffer.
If we are unable to protect our intellectual property, our brands and business could be damaged.
Infrastructure Risks
Unforeseen disruptions in our distribution and fulfillment centers could have an adverse impact on our business and operations.
Failure of a key information technology system or process could adversely affect our business.
AI creates business, legal and ethical challenges.
Disruptions in our customer-facing technology systems could impair our digital retail strategy and give rise to negative customer experiences.
Information Security, Cybersecurity, Privacy and Data Management Risks
A breach of our information technology systems could adversely affect our reputation, business partner and customer relationships and operations and result in higher costs.
Supply Chain and Third-Party Risks
Disruption of global sourcing activities and quality and other concerns over our own brands could negatively impact brand reputation and earnings.
Material disruptions in relationships with third-parties with whom the Company does business could adversely affect its operations.
Economic, Global, Legal and External Risks
The Company's business is subject to discretionary consumer spending, unfavorable economic and political conditions and other related risks.
Our business could be materially adversely affected by extreme weather conditions, natural disasters or regional or global health pandemics.
Legislation, litigation, regulatory requirements or non-compliance could adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Climate Change-Related Risks
Climate change, or legal, regulatory, or market measures to address climate change, could adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Financial Risks
We have incurred losses due to impairment of tangible and intangible long-lived assets.
Inability to access capital markets could adversely affect our business or financial condition.
paragraphs: In evaluating the Company, the risks described below and the matters described under "Forward-Looking Statements" should be considered carefully. Such risks and matters are numerous and diverse, may be experienced continuously or intermittently, and may vary in intensity and effect. Although the risks are organized by heading, and each risk is described separately, many of the risks are interrelated. Any of such risks and matters, individually or in combination, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows, as well as on the attractiveness and value of an investment in the Company's securities. While we believe we have identified and discussed below the key risk factors affecting our business, there may be additional risks and uncertainties that are not presently known or that are not currently believed to be significant that may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations or cash flows in the future.

We completed the second year executing Bold New Chapter, a strategy that prioritizes improving the shopping environment and elevating the customer experience, while closing unproductive Macy's stores to focus resources and investments on the go-forward enterprises. Progress on the three pillars within the strategy included:

•Strengthen and reimagine the Macy's nameplate: overlaying successful initiatives from the First 50 to an additional 75 stores for a total 125 reimagined Macy's locations, and revitalizing merchandise assortment with a mix of newness and fashion;
•Accelerate luxury growth: new brand launches and exclusive partnerships at Bloomingdale's and continued comparable sales growth at Bluemercury; and

•Simplify and modernize end-to-end operations: opened new state-of-the-art fulfillment and store replenishment center, China Grove, helping to modernize our supply chain and providing the opportunity to increase accuracy and timeliness of deliveries, reduce delivery costs, invest in growth ambitions and simplify our business model.

We plan to continue to make value-enhancing investments to support these initiatives primarily focused on digital and technology, data and analytics, supply chain modernization and omni-channel capabilities. These initiatives have required and will continue to require our management, colleagues and contractors to make changes in our business operations and to improve productivity and profitability, and are subject to the ability to attract and retain skilled personnel to support the initiatives. We face challenges in executing the Bold New Chapter strategy and initiatives in the current environment of heightened inflation, tariffs, economic uncertainty, geopolitical disruption and other macroeconomic conditions that may impact discretionary spending. Our ability to achieve sustainable, profitable growth is subject to the successful implementation of our strategic plans and realization of anticipated benefits and savings. If we are unable to successfully execute our strategic plans and initiatives to achieve the intended results or these investments or initiatives do not perform as expected or create implementation or operational challenges, our profitability and growth could suffer.

paragraphs: The Company completed its second year of the execution of its Bold New Chapter strategy, which is focused on the needs of our customer and is centered on an enhanced omni-channel shopping experience across all three of our nameplates. This strategy prioritizes improving the shopping environment and elevating the customer experience, while closing underproductive Macy's stores to focus resources and investments on its go-forward enterprise. During fiscal 2025, the Company continued to make progress on the three pillars within the Bold New Chapter strategy, as follows:
•Strengthen and Reimagine Macy's nameplate

◦Reimagine 125 Locations: In early February 2025, we overlaid successful initiatives from the First 50 locations to an additional 75 stores for a total of 125 reimagined Macy's locations. The investments in the additional 75 stores have continued emphasis on customer experience, and build on learnings from the first year of our Bold New Chapter strategy. The Reimagine 125 locations outperformed the rest of the Macy's fleet in 2025. These locations are now better organized, easier to shop and have a more compelling visual presentation. Within each category we are driving higher interest and engagement through increased differentiation. We are carving out floor space to leverage new trends while maintaining a presence in existing categories and brands.

◦Revitalize assortment: Our assortment matrix evolution continues to gain traction as we elevate our product curation to deliver a more compelling mix of newness and fashion. Our merchants continue to be focused on clarity of offering, enhanced variety and reduced redundancies. Our strong balance sheet, large addressable market and loyal customer base are attractive differentiators to brands and partners. Our off-price concept, Backstage, and digital Macy's Marketplace remained strong. Backstage and Marketplace fill white space in our assortments and help us maintain loyal customers seeking more price and brand variety.

◦Customer Experience: We are supporting our omnichannel customer experience by investing in colleagues that includes rolling out enhanced education, a tiered approach to staffing and events and dedicated colleagues for specific merchandise areas. In addition, we are taking a more localized approach to enable store-level empowerment and deliver against distinct customer preferences in each of the markets we serve.Through these efforts, in 2025, Macy's delivered its best net promoter score on record.

◦Bloomingdale's: Bloomingdale's achieved its highest owned-plus-licensed-plus-marketplace comparable sales growth in 14 quarters, sequential improvement in its net promoter score and its best holiday on record. From a category perspective, fragrance, women's contemporary, designer apparel and fine jewelry were standout contributors to this performance. We introduced several new brands that are already driving results including Totem, Christian Louboutin, Victoria Beckham Beauty, Skims, Messika and Vuori. These brands are inspiring existing customers, attracting new ones and further strengthening Bloomingdale's relevancy.

◦Bluemercury: Bluemercury achieved its 20th consecutive quarter and sixth consecutive year of comparable sales growth. Results continued to be driven by expanded brand partnerships in dermatological skincare, color and fragrance including Skinceuticals, Dr Diamonds Metacine, Sisley Paris and Parfums De Marley.
•Simplify and modernize end-to-end operations

◦Efforts to drive meaningful change for our customers, and operational and financial performance, continue to progress. We opened our new state-of-the-art fulfillment and store replenishment center, China Grove, which incorporates automation, robotics and artificial intelligence into our delivery ecosystem. The facility helps modernize and strengthen our supply chain and provides us the opportunity to increase accuracy and timeliness of deliveries and further reduce our delivery costs. Our end-to-end work gives us the ability to invest in our growth ambitions, while simplifying our business model.
Comparable sales highlights for 2025 versus 2024 related to components of the Bold New Chapter strategy are as follows:
•Macy's, Inc. comparable sales were up 1.5% on an owned-plus-licensed-plus-marketplace basis.
◦Macy's, Inc. go-forward business comparable sales, inclusive of go-forward locations and digital across nameplates, were up 1.7% on an owned-plus-licensed-plus-marketplace basis.

paragraphs: Macy's, Inc. (the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") 為一間首屈一指的全通路零售企業，經營 665 間門市、網站及行動應用程式，旗下擁有三個知名品牌：Macy's、Bloomingdale's 與 Bluemercury。本公司銷售廣泛的商品，包括服飾與配件、化妝品、居家用品及其他消費性商品，並服務於從注重性價比的折扣消費者到高階豪華消費者等多樣化的客羣。Macy's, Inc. 藉由其多品牌、多類別與多通路模式，提供高程度的靈活性以應對消費者需求的變化，並服務近 4000 萬名活躍消費者。
•Macy's 為一間現代化的百貨公司，提供廣泛的商品，包括男裝、女裝與童裝服飾與配件、化妝品、居家用品及其他消費性商品。Macy's 透過在實體與數位通路上提供具吸引力、高品質的商品、競爭性價格與值得信賴的客戶服務，吸引廣泛的中高收入客羣。為服務不同的客羣與商圈，Macy's 運作全線與較小規模的門市，並透過 Macy's Backstage 品牌提供折扣零售概念。

•Bloomingdale's 自 150 年前成立以來，代表本公司高階、優質的現代至豪華百貨商店。Bloomingdale's 服務富裕的跨世代客羣，並透過活潑且高度精選的購物環境，搭配卓越的客戶服務，定位為發現商店。Bloomingdale's 透過其全線與較小規模的門市、Bloomies，以及其折扣零售概念 Bloomingdale's The Outlet，服務不同的客羣與商圈。此外，Blooming,dale's 透過其在迪拜、阿拉伯聯合大公國與阿扎赫拉、科威特的授權合作夥伴，維持全球存在。
•Bluemercury 為一間首屈一指的高階美容與水療服務零售商，透過強調高度個人化、高品質且無品牌偏見的美容互動，於便利的社區門市中開創獨特的客戶為先服務模式。Bluemercury 的商品組合針對富裕的美容愛好者，重點放在高階皮膚科護膚、臨牀治療與升級的香氛系列。
Macy's, Inc. 於 1985 年在特拉華州設立為公司，並與其前身一起自 1830 年開始經營百貨商店。
我們的多年企業戰略，Bold New Chapter，旨在協助本公司回歸可持續且獲利的成長，透過改善客戶體驗、提升商品相關性、進化門市與數位足跡、投資業務成長領域以及現代化運營模式。此戰略以三個支柱為組織：
•強化與重新定義 Macy's 品牌：我們專注於透過改善客戶服務、提升與現代化商品組合與品牌精選，以及優先投資未來門市，為 Macy's 提供更相關且一致的全通路體驗。
•加速與區隔豪華品牌：我們將 Bloomingdale's 與 Bluemercury 觀視為我們資產組中區隔成長的平台，並投資這些品牌以支持區隔的商品精選、提升客戶服務以及擴展數位與選擇性實體門市。
•簡化並現代化端到端作業：我們正在現代化營運模式，以降低複雜度、提高速度、可靠性與存貨效益，並透過營運效率所帶來的成本節省，自籌面對客戶的投資。
我們銷售廣泛的商品，包括服飾與配件（男裝、女裝與童裝）、化妝品、居家裝飾及其他消費性商品。特定商品種類會根據商店規模、商品組合及貿易區域的客戶特質而有所不同。
大多數商店位於都會或近郊地區，主要分佈於美國人口密集的地區。

paragraphs: 本公司完成其 Bold New Chapter 策略的第二年執行，該策略聚焦於客戶需求，並以強化跨所有三個品牌名稱的全通路購物體驗為中心。此策略優先考量改善購物環境與提升客戶體驗，同時關閉低效益的 Macy's 經營據點，以集中資源與投資於未來企業發展。在財務 2025 年，本公司持續在 Bold New Chapter 策略的三大支柱上取得進展，如下所述：
•強化與重新構思 Macy's 品牌名稱

◦重新構思 125 個據點：於 2025 年 2 月初，我們將首 50 個據點的成功措施應用於另外 75 個據點，總計重新構思 125 個 Macy's 擬真據點。對另外 75 個據點的投資持續強調客戶體驗，並建立於我們 Bold New Chapter 策略第一年的經驗。重新構思 125 個據點在 2025 年表現優於 Macy's 其他據點。這些據點現在組織更完善、購物更便利，並有更具吸引力的視覺呈現。在每一個商品類別中，我們透過增加差異化來提高客戶興趣與參與度。我們正在劃分樓層空間以利用新趨勢，同時維持在現有類別與品牌的現有存在。

◦重新活化商品組合：我們的商品組合矩陣演進持續獲得關注，我們提升商品策劃以提供更具吸引力的新品與時尚組合。我們的經銷商持續專注於提供明確的選擇、增強多樣性與減少重複。我們強大的資產負債表、廣大的可接觸市場與忠實客戶羣是對品牌與合作夥伴的吸引力差異點。我們的折扣概念 Backstage 與數位 Macy's 市場處於強勢。Backstage 與 Marketplace 填補我們商品組閤中的空白，並幫助我們維持忠實客戶尋求更多價格與品牌選擇。
◦客戶體驗：我們透過投資員工來支持我們的全通路客戶體驗，包括推出增強的教育訓練、分層的員工配置與活動，以及專門負責特定商品區的員工。此外，我們採用更在地化的做法，以賦予據點自主權並針對我們服務的每個市場的獨特客戶偏好進行服務。透過這些努力，於 2025 年，Macy's 達成其有史以來最佳的淨促進者分數。

◦Bloomingdale's：Bloomingdale's 達成其 14 季度以來最高的自有加授權加市場處的可比銷售成長，連續改善其淨促進者分數，並創下最佳聖誕節紀錄。從商品類別而言，香水、女性時尚、設計師服飾與高級珠寶是此表現的突出貢獻者。我們引入數個新品牌，這些品牌已經開始產生成效，包括 Totem、Christian Louboutin、Victoria Beckham Beauty、Skims、Messika 與 Vuori。這些品牌激勵現有客戶、吸引新客戶，並進一步強化 Bloomingdale's 的相關性。
◦Bluemercury：Bluemercury 達成連續 20 個季度與連續 6 年的可比銷售成長。結果持續受到擴展的皮膚護理、色彩與香水品牌合作夥伴的推動，包括 Skinceuticals、Dr Diamonds Metacine、Sisley Paris 與 Parfums De Marley。
•簡化與現代化端到端作業
◦持續推動對客戶有意義的改變以及營運與財務表現，仍持續進行中。我們啟用了全新的一流配送與門市補貨中心China Grove，該中心將自動化、機械人與人工智慧融入配送生態系統。此設施有助於現代化並強化我們的供應鏈，並提供我們增加配送準確性與及時性，進一步降低配送成本的機會。我們的端到端作業使我們能投資於成長願景，同時簡化商業模式。
2025年與2024年比較銷售重點，與Bold New Chapter策略的各個組成部分相關，如下所述：
• Macy's, Inc. 的可比銷售額按自有加授權加市集基礎計算，成長1.5%。
◦ Macy's, Inc. 未來業務的可比銷售額，包含未來據點與跨品牌數位銷售，按自有加授權加市集基礎計算，成長1.7%。

headings: 戰略、運營與競爭風險
本公司的戰略計畫與措施可能無法成功，這可能會對本公司的獲利能力與成長造成負面影響。
本公司可能無法及時識別或有效回應消費者的需要、期望或趨勢，這可能會對本公司與客戶的關係、產品與服務的需求以及市場佔有率造成不利影響。
本公司的廣告、行銷與忠誠度計畫可能無法成功。
本公司的銷售與營運結果取決於本公司管理存貨、商品選項並防範存貨不足的能力。
本公司面臨著極大的競爭，並依賴於其在零售業不斷變化的環境中區隔自身的能力。
本公司成長的能力部分取決於本公司商店能否持續對消費者具有吸引力與相關性。
本公司可能無法成功執行其不動產策略。
本公司營業收入及現金需求受業務季節性影響。
我們依賴本公司吸引、培訓、發展及留住優質員工的能力。
勞動成本及員工福利成本增加可能影響本公司財務結果及現金流。
若本公司私人標籤及合作品牌信用卡收入下降，財務及營運結果可能受到負面影響。
本公司確定福利計畫資金需求或計畫結清費用可能影響財務結果及現金流。
若本公司聲譽及品牌形象無法維持高水平，營運及財務結果可能受損。
若本公司無法保護智慧財產權，本公司品牌及業務可能受損。
基礎建設風險
未預見的分銷與履行中心中斷，可能對本公司業務與營運產生不利影響。
關鍵資訊科技系統或流程失敗，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
人工智能創造出商業、法律與倫理上的挑戰。
面對客戶的科技系統中斷，可能影響本公司數位零售策略，並導致負面的客戶體驗。
資訊安全、網路安全、隱私權與資料管理風險
本公司資訊科技系統遭入侵，可能對本公司聲譽、業務夥伴與客戶關係及營運產生不利影響，並導致成本增加。
供應鏈與第三方風險
全球採購活動中斷及品質及其他對本公司自有品牌之關注，可能對品牌聲譽與獲利產生負面影響。
與本公司從事業務之第三方關係發生重大中斷，可能對其營運產生不利影響。
經濟、全球、法律及外部風險
本公司業務受隨機性消費支出、不利之經濟與政治環境及其他相關風險影響。
極端天氣條件、自然災害或區域性或全球性健康大流行，可能對本公司業務產生重大不利影響。
立法、訴訟、規範要求或非合規，可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
與氣候變遷相關之風險
氣候變遷，或為應對氣候變遷而採取之法律、規範或市場措施，可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
財務風險
本公司因有形及無形長壽命資產減損而產生虧損。
無法取得資本市場資金可能不利於本公司業務或財務狀況。
paragraphs: 在評估本公司時，應謹慎考慮下列所描述的風險及「前瞻性陳述」部分所述的事項。這些風險及事項數量眾多且各異，可能持續或間歇地發生，且其強度與影響可能有所不同。雖然風險已按標題分類，且每項風險皆單獨說明，但許多風險之間是相互關聯的。任何上述風險及事項，無論單獨或組合，都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流造成重大不利影響，同時也對投資本公司證券的吸引力與價值造成重大不利影響。儘管我們認為已識別並討論了影響我們業務的主要風險因素，但可能還有其他風險與不確定性尚未被識別，或目前認為不具重大影響，但未來可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果或現金流造成不利影響。
我們已完成執行「Bold New Chapter」第二年，這是一項以改善購物環境與提升顧客體驗為優先，同時關閉不具生產力的 Macy's 經營據點，以集中資源與投資於未來企業的策略。該策略下三大支柱的進展包括：
•強化並重新定義 Macy's 品牌：將第一階段 50 家成功計畫的成果覆蓋至另外 75 家據點，總計 125 家重新定義的 Macy's 經營據點，並透過新產品與時尚商品的組合，重新活化商品種類；
•加速奢華品牌成長：在 Bloomingdale's 發布新品牌與獨家合作夥伴，並持續維持 Bluemercury 的可比銷售成長；
•簡化並現代化端到端營運：啟用新落成的先進物流與門市補貨中心 China Grove，有助於現代化我們的供應鏈，並提供提高配送準確性與及時性、降低配送成本、投資成長願景與簡化業務模式的機會。

我們計畫持續進行能提升價值的投資，以支持這些計畫，主要聚焦於數位與科技、數據與分析、供應鏈現代化與全通路能力。這些計畫已要求並將持續要求我們的管理階層、同仁與承包商改變業務營運方式，以提高生產力與獲利能力，且這些計畫的執行取決於吸引並留住具專業技能人才的能力。我們在當前高通貨膨脹、關稅、經濟不確定性、地緣政治幹擾及其他總體經濟條件的環境中執行「Bold New Chapter」策略與計畫，可能影響可支配支出。我們實現可持續且獲利成長的能力，取決於我們戰略計畫的成功執行與預期效益與節省的實現。若我們無法成功執行戰略計畫與計畫以達成預期結果，或這些投資與計畫未如預期表現，或造成執行或營運上的困難，我們的獲利與成長可能受到影響。
